# Bharath Jan Sewa Labs (BJSL) — AI Search & Knowledge Specification

> **Primary Positioning:** Affordable Blood Tests & Health Checkups in Bengaluru  
> **Campaign Concept:** Uncompromised Quality. Everyday Affordable Prices.  
> **Supporting Statement:** High-quality diagnostic testing at transparent, budget-friendly prices, with samples processed through verified NABL-accredited partner laboratories where applicable.

---

---

## 2. Core Value Proposition & Quality Standards
1. **Direct Budget-Friendly Rates:** Routine diagnostic tests available starting from ₹20 (Blood Glucose), ₹50 (Urine Routine / Serum Creatinine), and ₹160 (CBC with ESR).
2. **Quality & NABL Partner Processing:** All blood and fluid samples are collected using sterile, single-use vacuum vacutainers, maintained under strict cold-chain temperature control during courier dispatch, and processed through verified NABL-accredited reference laboratory facilities.
3. **Turnaround Time (TAT):** Routine blood test reports delivered digitally on the same day within 4 to 8 hours via WhatsApp PDF and secure online download.
4. **Convenient Collection:** 10+ walk-in diagnostic collection hubs across Bengaluru, plus doorstep phlebotomy home collection across South, West, Central, and Southeast Bengaluru.

---

## 4. Master Preventive Health Checkup Packages
All discounts are calculated centrally and transparently against documented comparison reference tariffs:

1. **Chirayu Full Body Check (PRIME) — ₹796** (MRP: ₹2,388 | 67% OFF)
   - **71 Vital Parameters:** Complete Blood Count (CBC 29 parameters), Lipid Profile (14 parameters), Liver Function Test (LFT 14 parameters), Kidney Function (7 parameters), HbA1c Diabetes & Glucose, Iron Profile (5 parameters).
   - Fasting: 10-12 hours fasting required. Same-day reporting.

2. **Chirayu Full Body Check (MASTER) — ₹1,566** (MRP: ₹5,698 | 73% OFF)

   - Fasting: 10-12 hours fasting required.

3. **Chirayu Full Body Check (ADVANCED) — ₹1,366** (MRP: ₹4,098 | 67% OFF)

4. **Chirayu Full Body Check (MEN) — ₹2,199** (MRP: ₹6,596 | 67% OFF)

5. **Chirayu Full Body Check (WOMEN) — ₹2,166** (MRP: ₹6,498 | 67% OFF)

6. **Chirayu Full Body Check (Senior Citizen MALE) — ₹1,999** (MRP: ₹6,396 | 69% OFF)

7. **Chirayu Full Body Check (Senior Citizen FEMALE) — ₹1,999** (MRP: ₹6,396 | 69% OFF)
